panels.title: Error Rate — ERROR log lines per minute (§11.3 Panel 1)
panels.description: Counts ERROR-level log lines from restaurant-service per minute. Spike detection — if restaurant-service logs many ERRORs, something is wrong.

panels.title: Feign Call Outcomes — success vs failure (§11.3 Panel 4)
panels.description: Tracks successful Feign calls to order-service vs FeignException catches. Detects when order-service is degraded and restaurant-service Feign calls start failing.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="talabat", service="restaurant-service"} | json | message =~ ".*Feign call to.*failed.*" [5m]))

panels.title: RabbitMQ Event Audit — published vs consumed (§11.3 Panel 3)
panels.description: Shows restaurant.status-changed and restaurant.rated events published, and order.placed/completed/cancelled events consumed. Filtered by routingKey MDC field.
